statements.attributed: realized shortwave infrared emission by doping Cr3+-Yb3+ ion pairs into Lu0.2Sc0.8BO3 host materials
statements.quote: Shortwave infrared (SWIR) emission was realized by Zhang and coworkers when they doped Cr3+-Yb3+ ion pairs into Lu0.2Sc0.8BO3 host materials.

statements.attributed: discovered that a combination of self-trapped exciton recombination of Cs2AgInCl6 with Ln3+ dopant-induced extra light-emitting channels resulted in Vis-NIR ultrabroadband emission from lead-free halide double perovskites
statements.quote: Jin and coworkers discovered that a combination of self-trapped exciton (STE) recombination of Cs2AgInCl6 with Ln3+ dopant-induced extra light-emitting channels resulted in Vis-NIR (400–2000 nm) ultrabroadband emission from lead-free halide double perovskites (DPs).

statements.attributed: developed a promising strategy for building AC-LED lamps by adding a blue-light excited blue persistent luminescence phosphor to the commercial orange‒red PersL phosphor
statements.quote: To achieve white light emission during dimming time, Yuan and coworkers developed a promising strategy for building AC-LED lamps by adding a blue-light excited blue persistent luminescence (PersL) phosphor to the commercial orange‒red PersL phosphor.

statements.attributed: reported a novel one-step approach for synthesizing hollow structured UCNPs without a template
statements.quote: In this special issue, An and coworkers report a novel one-step approach for synthesizing hollow structured UCNPs without a template.

statements.attributed: demonstrated the power of dimensional reduction in analyses of the emission spectra for lanthanide-doped nanothermometers
statements.quote: The power of dimensional reduction (DR) in analyses of the emission spectra for lanthanide-doped nanothermometers was demonstrated by Ximendes and coworkers.

statements.attributed: illustrated the impact of core-shell compositional architectures of UCNPs and the mode of photoexcitation on the realization of UC-FRET from UCNPs to Rose Bengal
statements.quote: Kotulska and coworkers illustrated the impact of core-shell compositional architectures of UCNPs and the mode of photoexcitation on the realization of UC-FRET from UCNPs to Rose Bengal (RB).

statements.attributed: prepared a brand new optical storage medium composed of UCNPs and EuSe semiconductors, in which the emission spectrum was excitation wavelength dependent
statements.quote: A brand new optical storage medium composed of UCNPs and EuSe semiconductors was prepared by Xie and coworkers, in which the emission spectrum was excitation wavelength dependent.

statements.attributed: presented the first direct observation of well-resolved hyperfine structure with the photoluminescence spectra of LiYF4:Ho single crystals and anti-crossings of hyperfine levels in a magnetic field
statements.quote: Boldyrev and coworkers presented the first direct observation of well-resolved hyperfine structure with the photoluminescence spectra of LiYF4:Ho single crystals and anti-crossings of hyperfine levels in a magnetic field from low-temperature high-resolution Fourier spectroscopy and a special technique for luminescence detection.

statements.attributed: explored a Nd3+-doped YVO4 nanotheranostic agent with good BBB permeability for bimodality imaging and sonodynamic therapy of orthotopic gliomas
statements.quote: In this special issue, Lv and coworkers explore a Nd3+-doped YVO4 nanotheranostic agent with good BBB permeability for bimodality imaging and sonodynamic therapy (SDT) of orthotopic gliomas.
